detail.longDescription: The Difference Between Growing and Just Staying Busy You have a full calendar. A new course you just signed up for. A goal you are chasing, and another one lined up right behind it. From the outside, it looks like you are doing the work. But if you are honest with yourself, some of that motion is not growth at all. It is a very sophisticated way of staying busy enough that you never have to sit still with the parts of yourself that actually need attention.
